jetty.semantics: Exact transition-integrated Jetty-time, not wall-clock blocked time; includes empty/completed exposure.

limits: A deterministic tested pair is not a global token minimum or repeated-run stability result.
Native-pop landmarks are not physical-link TX completion or end-to-end RTT.
Native class 0 identifies stage-2 weight traffic; class 1 is the measured ACK/response class, not automatically weight-only. Weight-only opcode totals use whole-Layer token subtraction.
Jetty-time occupancy and overlapping VOQ residence are not additive wall-clock stalls.
No universal Chunk drop counter is exported; conservation is a strong consistency contract, not omniscient event coverage.
Historical host cost is not strictly comparable because host and observer scope changed.

historical_chunk_terminal_prefix_compari.limit: Different workloads and actual critical source ports; exact elapsed partition comparison, not a controlled intervention or causal mediator decomposition.
